_about: Award rows whose YEAR is wrong in the Awards sheet. scripts/update-awards.py changes each matching row (same player, award and wrong year) to the right year after every fetch, before title teams are set. YEAR is the season's ending year. A row that no longer matches (the sheet was fixed) is skipped. If the sheet already has the right year too, the wrong row is dropped instead of kept twice.
